summary: rhaap:create-execution-environment creates an AAP execution environment. Inputs: token, optional deleteIfExist, and values with environmentName, organization {id}, image (full registry/name:tag, required), optional environmentDescription and pull policy (always, missing or never; default missing). Outputs executionEnvironment id, name and description.
questions: How do I create an execution environment from a Backstage template?
What pull policies does rhaap:create-execution-environment accept?
